entries.evidence: Catalog extract captured official PDP accordion Ingredients and How to Use sections for Cactus Nectar; current live row is blocked by Shopify variant JSON in raw ingredient fields.
entries.pdp_how_to_use_raw: Apply to clean skin. Follow with Face Oil and Moisturizers. Can be used as a makeup primer, body and hair mist, or refreshment during the day.
entries.pdp_ingredients_raw: AQUA, BETAINE, PROPANEDIOL, ETHYLHEXYL PELARGONATE, GLYCERYL CITRATE/LACTATE/LINOLEATE/OLEATE, GLYCERYL CAPRYLATE, POLYGLYCERYL-3 CAPRATE, POLYGLYCERYL-4 COCOATE, BENZYL ALCOHOL, ECTOIN, OPUNTIA FICUS-INDICA FRUIT EXTRACT, PARFUM (natural identical), DEHYDROACETIC ACID, LACTOBACILLUS FERMENT
